l-m-h2-b0d01-33.title: Ihe na-ezighị ezi n’ihe akaebe induction nke 2ⁿ>n² bụ gịnị?
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.goal: Soro usoro ihe akaebe induction nke 2ⁿ>n², ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, n’usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-aga nke ọma.
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.material: Ihe akaebe maka “maka n≥1, 2ⁿ>n²”. (1) Maka n=1, 2>1 bụ eziokwu (2) Ka e were na 2ᵏ>k², mgbe ahụ 2ᵏ⁺¹>2k² (3) Ebe 2k²≥(k+1)², 2ᵏ⁺¹>(k+1)² (4) Ya mere ọ bụ eziokwu maka n niile ≥1
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s1.r.a: 2>1 bụ eziokwu. Ngụkọta a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s1.r.b: A mụbara akụkụ abụọ nke ihe e chere na ọ bụ eziokwu site na 2, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s1.o.d: (4) Ebe e kwubiri na ọ bụ eziokwu maka n niile ≥1
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu a sitere n’usoro gara aga nke na-ezighị ezi. Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ihe ahụ dara.
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s1.explain: 2k²≥(k+1)² bụ eziokwu naanị mgbe k≥3. Mgbe k=2, 8≥9 abụghị eziokwu, na mgbe n=2, 4>4 abụghịkwa eziokwu.
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe k=2, 2k²≥(k+1)² bụ okwu ụgha bụ 8≥9, ya mere enweghị ike iji ya maka k niile. Ọ bụ ya mere (3) ji bụrụ ebe mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-33.s.s2.model.1: Nha nhata a bụ eziokwu naanị maka k≥3, ya mere enweghị ike ikwubi na ọ bụ eziokwu maka n niile ≥1; n’ezie, mgbe n=2, 2²=4>4 abụghị eziokwu.

l-m-h2-b0d02-02.title: Ịchọta njehie dị na ngwọta log₃2×log₂9
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta e ji chọta log₃2×log₂9, ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta, n'usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.material: Ngwọta ịchọta uru log₃2×log₂9. (1) log₃2=1/log₂3 (2) Ebe 9=3³, log₂9=3log₂3 (3) Ịmụba ha na-enye 3 (4) Ya mere uru ya bụ 3
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ngosipụta ziri ezi site n'ịgbanwe ntọala.
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s1.o.c: (3) Ebe e mụbara uru abụọ ahụ ma nweta 3
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s1.r.c: Ịmụba ngosipụta ndị gara aga ma kagbuo ihe ndị kwekọrọ na-enye ụdị ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s1.o.d: (4) Ebe e kwubiri na uru ya bụ 3
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-ebufe naanị nsonaazụ gara aga. Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ihe na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s2.model.0: 9=3², ma e dere ya dịka 3³, ya mere (2) ezighị ezi. Ebe log₂9=2log₂3, ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-02.s.s2.model.1: Nnọchiaha 3 bụ 2, ya mere log₂9=2log₂3. Ya mere (1/log₂3)×2log₂3=2.

l-m-h2-b0d02-08.title: Ịchọta njehie na ngwọta ịchọta inverse nke y=3ˣ+1
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta e ji chọta inverse nke y=3ˣ+1, ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta, n'usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.material: Ngwọta ịchọta inverse nke y=3ˣ+1. (1) 3ˣ=y−1 (2) x=log₃y−1 (3) Gbanwee x na y ka ị nweta y=log₃x−1 (4) Ngalaba bụ x>0
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.o.a: (1) Ebe e haziri ya ka ọ bụrụ 3ˣ=y−1
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.r.a: Iwepụ 1 n'akụkụ abụọ na-enye 3ˣ=y−1, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.o.c: (3) Ebe a gbanwere x na y
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ usoro ịchọta ọrụ inverse, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.o.d: (4) Ebe e nyere ngalaba dịka x>0
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.r.d: Njehie dị n'ngosipụta gara aga ka gafere n'ebe a. Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s1.explain: Site na 3ˣ=y−1, x=log₃(y−1). Ọrụ inverse bụ y=log₃(x−1), ngalaba ya bụ x>1.
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe e weere logarithm nke 3ˣ=y−1, ihe niile dị n'ime logarithm bụ y−1; ya mere x=log₃(y−1). Ọrụ inverse bụ y=log₃(x−1).
l-m-h2-b0d02-08.s.s2.model.1: Ebe y−1 bụ otu ihe dum nke ghọrọ ike nke 3, enweghị ike iwepụ 1 ahụ n'èzí logarithm; a ghaghị ide ya dịka x=log₃(y−1).

l-m-h2-b0d02-18.title: Oke kacha elu nke y=cos²x−2cosx: kedu ebe njehie ahụ mere?
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.topic: Oke kacha elu na kacha ala nke ọrụ trigonometric
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta maka oke kacha elu na kacha ala nke y=cos²x−2cosx, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.material: Nzọụkwụ ngwọta maka oke kacha elu na kacha ala nke y=cos²x−2cosx. (1) Ịtọ t=cosx na-enye −1≤t≤1 (2) y=t²−2t=(t−1)²−1 (3) A kpọrọ uru y nke vertex, −1, oke kacha elu (4) Oke kacha ala bụ 3, mgbe t=−1
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.o.a: (1) Ebe e setịpụrụ t=cosx ma dee −1≤t≤1
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ oke uru cosx, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.o.b: (2) Ebe e degharịrị ya dịka y=(t−1)²−1
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.r.b: t²−2t=(t−1)²−1, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.o.c: (3) Ebe a kpọrọ uru vertex −1 oke kacha elu
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.o.d: (4) Ebe a kpọrọ 3 mgbe t=−1 oke kacha ala
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.r.d: Nke a sitere n’ịgbaso ntụnyere dị na (3). Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ihe dara.
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s1.explain: Uru vertex −1 nke parabola na-emeghe elu bụ nke kacha nta. 3 mgbe t=−1 bụ nke kacha elu.
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s2.model.0: y=(t−1)²−1 na-emeghe elu; ya mere uru vertex −1 bụ nke kacha nta, 3 mgbe t=−1 bụkwa nke kacha elu.
l-m-h2-b0d02-18.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe t=1, uru ya bụ −1; mgbe t=−1, ọ bụ 3, ya mere nke ka ukwuu bụ 3. Uru vertex abụghị mgbe niile nke kacha elu.

l-m-h2-b0d02-22.title: Chọta njehie dị na ngwọta radius okirikiri mpụta
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta na-eji Iwu Sine chọta radius okirikiri mpụta (usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta), chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.material: Ngwọta ịchọta radius okirikiri mpụta R nke triangle ABC mgbe A=30° na a=5. (1) Iwu Sine a/sinA=2R (2) sin30°=1/2 (3) 5÷(1/2)=10 (4) Ya mere R=10
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.s.s1.r.a: Akụkụ aka nri nke Iwu Sine bụ 2R, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.s.s1.r.b: sin30°=1/2, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.s.s1.o.d: (4) Ebe e si na 2R=10 kwubie R=10
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.s.s1.explain: a/sinA=2R=10; ya mere R=5. Echefuru nzọụkwụ ikewa site na 2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.s.s2.model.0: Uru 10 nke a/sinA bụ 2R; ya mere R bụ ọkara ya, 5. Nzọụkwụ (4) nke were 10 dịka R ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-22.s.s2.model.1: N'iwu Sine, akụkụ aka nri bụ 2R, ọ bụghị R; ya mere 10=2R, a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ R=5.

l-m-h2-b0d02-34.title: Ihe na-efu n'ihe akaebe induction na-ekwu 'n²+n bụ odd'?
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.goal: Soro usoro ihe akaebe induction na-egosi na n²+n na-abụ ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ mgbe niile (usoro ihe kpatara ya na nsonaazụ ya), chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.material: Ihe akaebe na “n²+n bụ ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ maka ọnụọgụ eke n ọ bụla”. (1) Were na k²+k bụ ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ mgbe n=k (2) (k+1)²+(k+1)=(k²+k)+2(k+1) (3) ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ+ọnụọgụ ekewa abụọ=ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ, ya mere ọ dịkwa maka n=k+1 (4) Ọ dịịrị ọnụọgụ eke n niile
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.a: (1) Ebe o chere na nkwupụta ahụ bụ eziokwu maka n=k
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ echiche a na-eji na nzọụkwụ induction, ya mere ọ dị mma.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.b: Ịgbasa ya na-enye otu ngosipụta ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.c: (3) Ebe e kwuru na ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ+ọnụọgụ ekewa abụọ=ọnụọgụ na-adịghị ekewa abụọ
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ iwu ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.d: (4) Ebe e kwubiri na ọ dịịrị ha niile n'enweghị ịlele n=1
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.explain: Nzọụkwụ mmalite n=1 adịghị. 1²+1=2 bụ ọnụọgụ ekewa abụọ; n'ezie, n²+n na-abụ ọnụọgụ ekewa abụọ mgbe niile.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.0: O nwere naanị nzọụkwụ induction, ma ọ naghị elele ọnọdụ n=1, ya mere ihe akaebe ahụ anaghị arụ ọrụ. 1²+1=2 bụ ọnụọgụ ekewa abụọ, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.1: Enweghị nzọụkwụ mmalite, o nweghị ebe a ga-esi malite, ya mere a pụghị iwepụta nkwubi okwu (4). Ọzọkwa, n²+n=n(n+1) na-abụ ọnụọgụ ekewa abụọ mgbe niile, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ n'onwe ya ezighị ezi.

l-m-h2-b0d03-05.title: Ịkagbu ihe mgbe ala bụ ike abụọ: ebee ka o si hie ụzọ?
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta na-achọta lim (x²−1)/(x−1)² (x→1), chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi n'usoro ihe kpatara ya na nsonaazụ ya, ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.material: Ngwọta: ① x²−1=(x−1)(x+1) ② Ịkagbu ya na (x−1)² dị n'ala na-ahapụ naanị x+1 ③ Ka x→1, x+1→2 ④ Oke bụ 2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Ịkagbu ya na-ahapụ naanị x+1
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.c: Mgbakọ a ziri ezi, ma nzọụkwụ gara aga ezighị ezi ugbua.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu ahụ ezighị ezi n'ihi ②. Ọ bụghị ebe njehie mbụ dị.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.explain: (x−1)(x+1)/(x−1)²=(x+1)/(x−1). Ebe (x−1) ka dị n'ala, oke ahụ adịghị.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.0: A pụrụ ịkagbu naanị otu (x−1) n'ime (x−1)²; nke fọdụrụ bụ (x+1)/(x−1), ya mere ② ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.1: Ebe (x−1) ka dị n'ala, uru ahụ na-eto ma ọ bụ na-ebelata n'enweghị njedebe ka x→1, ya mere oke adịghị. ②, ebe e mere ka a ga-asị na ịkagbu ya agwụla, bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-h2-b0d03-11.title: Uru e nwetara site na nkọwa derivative: ahịrị nke mbụ mejọrọ bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta na-eji nkọwa chọta f'(2) maka f(x)=x²+3x (usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta), chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.material: f(x)=x²+3x. Ngwọta: ① f(2)=10 ② f(2+h)=4+h²+6+3h ③ (f(2+h)−f(2))/h=(h²+3h)/h=h+3 ④ Mgbe h→0, f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ebe e kpochapụrụ iji nweta h+3
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.c: Dịka nsonaazụ ② si dị, ngụkọta a ziri ezi. Ebe mbụ mejọrọ bụ ②.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu ahụ ezighị ezi, ma ihe kpatara ya dị na usoro gara aga.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.explain: (2+h)²=4+4h+h². E wepụrụ okwu etiti 4h, ya mere e nwetara 3 kama f'(2)=7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.0: E dere (2+h)² dịka 4+h², e wepụrụ 4h; ② bụ mmejọ mbụ, ma ọ bụrụ na e mere ya nke ọma, (7h+h²)/h→7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.1: E sochighị usoro ịmụba (2+h)²=4+4h+h², ya mere mmejọ ahụ malitere na ②, a ga-edozikwa ya ka ọ bụrụ f'(2)=7.

l-m-h2-b0d03-20.title: Ngwọta na-eme tebụl akara: ebe mmejọ mbụ dị bụ ebe aṅaa?
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta gbasara ịrị elu na ọdịda nke f(x)=x³−3x² (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta), chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.material: f(x)=x³−3x². Ngwọta: ① f'(x)=3x²−6x ② Site na f'(x)=0, x=0 ma ọ bụ x=2 ③ Maka x<0, f'(x)=3x(x−2)<0 ④ Ya mere enwere oke kacha ala mpaghara na x=0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.o.b: ② x=0 ma ọ bụ x=2
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.r.b: Ndị a bụ ngwọta nke 3x(x−2)=0, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.o.d: ④ Oke kacha ala mpaghara na x=0
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu na-ezighị ezi sitere na ③. Ọ bụghị mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x<0, mgbe ahụ 3x<0 na x−2<0, ya mere f'(x)>0. N’aka ekpe x=0 ọ na-arịgo, wee malite ịda; ya mere ọ bụ oke kacha elu mpaghara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s2.model.0: Maka x<0, 3x na x−2 abụọ adịghị mma, ya mere ngwaahịa f'(x) dị mma; nke a pụtara na ③ bụ mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s2.model.1: f' dị mma n’aka ekpe nke x=0 ma dị njọ n’aka nri; ya mere x=0 bụ oke kacha elu mpaghara, ọ bụghị oke kacha ala.

l-m-h2-b0d03-26.title: Integral nwere oke nke absolute value: ahịrị nke mbụ nwere njehie bụ nkee?
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta integral nwere oke nke |x| site na −1 ruo 1 (ma ọ bụ njikọ ihe kpatara ya na nsonaazụ ya), chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.material: Ngwọta integral nwere oke nke |x| site na −1 ruo 1: ① |x| bụ −x maka x<0, x maka x≥0 ② Ya mere dochie |x| na x ma jikọta ya niile otu mgbe ③ Integral nwere oke nke x bụ [x²/2]=0 ④ Ya mere uru ya bụ 0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.a: ① Kewaa ngosipụta |x| dịka akụkụ etiti dị iche iche
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.b: ② Dochie |x| na x ma jikọta ya niile otu mgbe
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.c: ③ Integral nwere oke nke x bụ 0
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.c: Mgbakọ a n'onwe ya ziri ezi. Nsogbu bụ ngosipụta e guzobere n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu na-ezighi ezi sitere na ②.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.explain: Maka x<0, |x|=−x. (integral nwere oke nke −x site na −1 ruo 0)+(integral nwere oke nke x site na 0 ruo 1)=1/2+1/2=1.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, e jiri |x|=x dochie ya n'ogologo etiti niile, ma maka x<0, |x|=−x; ya mere a ga-ekewa etiti ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s2.model.1: Site na −1 ruo 0 anyị ga-ejikọta −x, ya mere ② ezighị ezi. Ịkewa ya nke ọma na-enye 1/2+1/2=1.

l-m-h2-b0d04-05.title: Oke nke denominator bụ 0; anyị ka nwere ike iji iwu oke nkewa?
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta lim (x²−1)/(x−1) ka x→1, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere site n'usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.material: Ngwọta: ① Ka x→1, oke x²−1 bụ 0 ② Oke x−1 bụkwa 0 ③ Oke nke nkewa bụ nkewa oke ndị ahụ; ya mere 0÷0=1 ④ Oke ahụ bụ 1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.r.a: Itinye x=1 na-enye 0; ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu na-ezighị ezi sitere na ③.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s1.explain: Iwu oke nkewa nwere ike ịrụ naanị mgbe oke denominator abụghị 0. Iwepụ (x−1) na-enye x+1; ya mere oke ziri ezi bụ 2.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ oke denominator bụ 0, a pụghị iji iwu nkewa; 0÷0 enweghị uru a kapịrị ọnụ; ya mere ③ ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-05.s.s2.model.1: Iwepụ (x−1) na-enye x+1; ya mere oke bụ 2. Nke a pụtara na ③ nke kwuru 0÷0=1 bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-h2-b0d04-14.title: Inyocha ngwọta na-achọta unknown site n'ọnọdụ local minimum
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta na-eji local minimum f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere site n'usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.material: f(x)=x³+ax²+bx nwere local minimum −1 na x=1. Ngwọta: ① f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ② Uru local minimum bụ −1; ya mere f'(1)=−1 ③ 3+2a+b=−1 ④ Dozie ya na ọnọdụ ọzọ iji chọta a na b.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.o.b: ② Uru local minimum bụ −1; ya mere f'(1)=−1
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.r.c: Okwu a na-esote ②; ya mere ② bụ njehie mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.o.d: ④ Dozie ya yana ọnọdụ ọzọ
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.r.d: Iji f(1)=−1 ziri ezi. ② bụ ebe mbụ hiere.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s1.explain: Ebe e nwere extreme value, f'(1)=0; uru local minimum −1 pụtara f(1)=−1. Site n'ọnọdụ abụọ a, a=−1, b=−1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s2.model.0: Uru local minimum ịbụ −1 pụtara f(1)=−1, ọ bụghị f'(1)=−1; ya mere ② ezighị ezi, a ga-eji f'(1)=0.
l-m-h2-b0d04-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere extreme value na x=1, tangent kwụ ọtọ, f'(1)=0; ya mere ② nke jiri −1 dịka derivative bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-h2-b0d04-15.title: Tangent nwere mkpọda 9: naanị otu isi tangency ọ dị?
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.goal: Soro usoro gbasara tangent y=x³−3x nwere mkpọda 9, chọta ebe mbụ o hiere site n'usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.material: Ịchọta isi tangency na curve y=x³−3x ebe tangent nwere mkpọda 9: ① y'=3x²−3 ② Site na 3x²−3=9, x²=4 ③ Ya mere x=2 ④ Isi tangency bụ (2, 2).
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.r.b: Ime 3x²−3=9 ka ọ dị mfe na-enye x²=4; ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.r.d: (2,2) bụ isi tangency, ma ịchọta naanị otu bụ n'ihi ③.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x²=4, x=2 ma ọ bụ x=−2. E nwere isi tangency abụọ, (2, 2) na (−2, −2), ha abụọ nwekwara mkpọda 9.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s2.model.0: x²=4 nwere azịza abụọ, 2 na −2; ya mere ③ chefuru −2. A ga-edozi ya n'ihi na e nwere ebe abụọ ahịrị tangent nwere mkpọda 9.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s2.model.1: Ebe y' nwere x², uru ya bụ otu mgbe x na −x; ya mere x=−2 bụkwa azịza, ebe tangent (−2, −2) dịkwa.

l-m-h2-b0d04-25.title: Ọrụ nke integral ya na-ejedebe na x: ebee ka ọ si hie ụzọ?
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta derivative nke g(x)=(integral nwere oke nke t²+2t site na 1 ruo x), chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.material: Mgbe g(x) bụ integral nwere oke nke (t²+2t) site na 1 ruo x, chọta g'(2). Ngwọta: ① Ka G'(t)=t²+2t, ya mere g(x)=G(x)−G(1) ② g'(x)=G'(x)−G'(1)=x²+2x−3 ③ g'(2)=4+4−3=5 ④ Azịza ya bụ 5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-agbaso nkọwa integral nwere oke, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.r.c: Mgbakọ ahụ na-agbaso ngosipụta ②; ya mere ② bụ ebe mbụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.r.d: Azịza na-ezighi ezi sitere na ②.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.explain: G(1) bụ constant, ya mere derivative ya bụ 0. g'(x)=G'(x)=x²+2x, g'(2)=8.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s2.model.0: G(1) bụ constant na-enweghị njikọ na x, ya mere derivative ya bụ 0. Na ② anyị ekwesịghị iwepụ G'(1); ya mere g'(x)=x²+2x.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s2.model.1: Oke ala bụ constant 1, ya mere G(1) na-apụ mgbe a na-eme differentiation nke g(x). A ga-edozi ya ka g'(2)=4+4=8.

l-m-h2-b0d05-20.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ụzọ isi kwụ n’ahịrị ụmụ nwoke 3 na ụmụ agbọghọ 2 ka ụmụ agbọghọ nọrọ ọnụ. Nzọụkwụ 1: were ụmụ agbọghọ 2 dịka otu ngwugwu. Nzọụkwụ 2: hazie ngwugwu na ụmụ nwoke 3, ngụkọta ihe 5: 5!=120. Nzọụkwụ 3: mụbaa na usoro 2! dị n’ime ngwugwu iji nweta 240.
l-m-h2-b0d05-20.s.s1.r.a: Iwere ụmụ agbọghọ abụọ dịka otu ngwugwu bụ mmalite dị mma.
l-m-h2-b0d05-20.s.s1.r.c: Ịmụba na usoro 2! dị n'ime ngwugwu ziri ezi. Ngụkọta tupu ya ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d05-20.s.s1.r.d: Azịza 240 ezighị ezi. Ụmụ nwoke 3 na otu ngwugwu bụ naanị ihe 4.
l-m-h2-b0d05-20.s.s1.explain: 1 ùkwù na ụmụ nwoke 3 na-eme ihe 4. 4!×2!=48 ziri ezi; Ahịrị 2 nke gụrụ 5! bụ njehie mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d05-20.s.s2.model.0: Na Ahịrị 2, 1 ùkwù na ụmụ nwoke 3 bụ ihe 4 n'ozuzu, ma a gụrụ ha dịka 5. Ya mere dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 4!=24 e mụbara site na 2!, nke bụ 48.

l-m-h2-b0d05-21.goal: Soro ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, maka ohere na otu dice ga-egosi 3 mgbe nchikọta bụ 7. Chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-h2-b0d05-21.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ohere na otu dice ga-egosi 3 mgbe a tụbara dice abụọ nchikọta bụ 7. Nzọụkwụ 1: ọnọdụ nchikọta 7 bụ (1,6)(2,5)(3,4)(4,3)(5,2)(6,1), ụzọ 6. Nzọụkwụ 2: ọnọdụ nwere 3 bụ (3,4)(4,3), ụzọ 2. Nzọụkwụ 3: ohere bụ 2/36=1/18.

l-m-h2-b0d05-21.s.s1.r.b: A chọtara ọnọdụ 2 nwere 3 nke ọma. Nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d05-21.s.s1.r.d: Ikewa site na ọnọdụ 36 niile na-enye ohere n'enweghị ọnọdụ.

l-m-h2-b0d05-23.title: Ọnụọgụ x² nke (2x+1)⁴ hiere ebee?
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.goal: Soro ngwọta ọnụọgụ x² na (2x+1)⁴, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ọnụọgụ x² na (2x+1)⁴. Nzọụkwụ 1: okwu izugbe bụ 4Cr·2·xʳ·1^(4-r). Nzọụkwụ 2: maka x², r=2. Nzọụkwụ 3: ọnụọgụ bụ 4C2×2=12.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.r.a: Azịza ziri ezi bụ 24; ya mere 12 ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.r.c: Iji nweta x², r=2 na xʳ; nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.r.d: Iji 4C2=6 ziri ezi. Njehie mbụ dị na nzọụkwụ bu ya ụzọ.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s1.explain: Ebe (2x)ʳ=2ʳxʳ, okwu izugbe bụ 4Cr·2ʳ·xʳ. Mgbe r=2, ọ bụ 6×4=24.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s2.model.0: Na Nzọụkwụ 1, e dere (2x)ʳ dịka 2xʳ, hapụ ike r nke 2. Ebe 2²=4, a ga-edozi ọnụọgụ ka ọ bụrụ 6×4=24.
l-m-h2-b0d05-23.s.s2.model.1: Ebe a mụbara 2x ugboro r, a mụbara 2 ugboro r kwa; okwu izugbe bụ 4Cr·2ʳxʳ, mgbe r=2 ọ bụ 6×4=24.

l-m-h2-b0d05-24.title: Inyocha ngwọta ịchọta ohere mgbe e mere standardization
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta P(X≥120) na nkesa normal, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta P(X≥120) mgbe X na-agbaso nkesa normal N(100, 10²). Nzọụkwụ 1: standardize Z=(X-100)/10. Nzọụkwụ 2: P(X≥120)=P(Z≥2). Nzọụkwụ 3: P(Z≥2)=P(0≤Z≤2)=0.4772.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.s.s1.r.a: P(Z≥2) bụ akụkụ aka nri; ya mere ọ pere mpe karịa 0.4772 nke ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.s.s1.r.c: Iwepụ mean 100 ma kewaa site na σ=10 bụ ụzọ ziri ezi iji standardize.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.s.s1.r.d: Ebe (120-100)/10=2, ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ P(Z≥2) ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.s.s1.explain: P(0≤Z≤2) dị n'etiti 0 na 2. Maka 2 ma ọ bụ karịa, wepụ na 0.5: 0.5-0.4772=0.0228.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.s.s2.model.0: Nzọụkwụ 3 chọtara ohere dị n'etiti 0 na 2. Z≥2 bụ akụkụ aka nri; ya mere dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 0.5-0.4772=0.0228.
l-m-h2-b0d05-24.s.s2.model.1: Ebe P(Z≥0)=0.5, iwepụ 0.4772, ohere dị n'etiti 0 na 2, na-enye ohere 2 ma ọ bụ karịa. Azịza ya bụ 0.0228.

l-m-h2-b0d06-19.title: Idepụta BANANA: kedu ebe njehie ahụ mere?
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) maka ọnụọgụ ụzọ ịhazi mkpụrụedemede BANANA n’usoro, chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ọnụọgụ ụzọ ịhazi mkpụrụedemede 6 niile nke BANANA n’ahịrị. Nzọụkwụ 1: B pụtara 1 ugboro, A ugboro 3, N ugboro 2. Nzọụkwụ 2: ịhazi mkpụrụedemede 6 n’ahịrị na-enye 6!=720. Nzọụkwụ 3: ebe ụfọdụ mkpụrụedemede bụ otu, kewaa na 3!+2!=8 iji nweta 90.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.s.s1.r.a: A gụrụ mkpụrụedemede ahụ nke ọma. Nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ mmalite dị mma iwere mkpụrụedemede 6 niile dịka ndị dị iche ma jiri 6!.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.s.s1.r.d: Azịza ziri ezi bụ 60, ya mere 90 ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.s.s1.explain: Nhazi 3! nke A ndị yiri na 2! nke N ndị yiri na-eme n’otu oge; ya mere atụkwasịla ha ọnụ, kewaa na ngwaahịa ha, 12. 720÷12=60.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.s.s2.model.0: Na nzọụkwụ 3, nhazi 3! na 2! nke mkpụrụedemede otu na-eme ọnụ, ya mere e kwesịghị ịgbakwunye ha, kama ịmụba ma kewaa na 12. Ya mere azịza bụ 60.
l-m-h2-b0d06-19.s.s2.model.1: Nkwughachi ndị ahụ dị iche n’otu n’otu: ụzọ 3! n’etiti A na 2! n’etiti N; ya mere a ga-edozi ya site n’ikewa na 3!×2!=12 iji nweta 720÷12=60.

l-m-h2-b0d06-20.title: Ịlele ngwọta ohere ịdọta opekata mpe bọọlụ ọcha 1
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) maka ohere na opekata mpe 1 n’ime bọọlụ 2 bụ ọcha, chọta mmejọ mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ohere na opekata mpe 1 bọọlụ ọcha mgbe a dọtara bọọlụ 2 n’otu oge n’akpa nwere bọọlụ ọcha 3 na ojii 4. Nzọụkwụ 1: ihe megidere ya bụ na bọọlụ 2 a dọtara bụ ojii. Nzọụkwụ 2: ohere ya bụ 4/7×4/7=16/49. Nzọụkwụ 3: azịza bụ 1-16/49=33/49.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.s.s1.r.a: Iwere ihe megidere ya dịka “ha abụọ bụ ojii” ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.s.s1.r.c: Iwepụ na 1 bụ usoro ziri ezi. Uru gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.s.s1.r.d: A dọtara bọọlụ ndị ahụ n’otu oge, ma a gbakọrọ ya dịka a na-eji otu bọọlụ ọzọ.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a dọtara ha n’otu oge, a pụghị ịdọta otu bọọlụ ọzọ. Ohere na ha abụọ bụ ojii bụ 4C2/7C2=6/21=2/7, azịza ya bụ 5/7.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.s.s2.model.0: Na nzọụkwụ 2, a dọtara bọọlụ 2 n’otu oge; mgbe e wepụrụ otu bọọlụ ojii, mụbaa na 3/6. 4/7×3/6=2/7, ya mere azịza bụ 5/7.
l-m-h2-b0d06-20.s.s2.model.1: 16/49 bụ uru mgbe e tinyere bọọlụ ahụ azụ, ya mere ọ dabaghị n’ajụjụ a. Idozi ya na 4C2/7C2=2/7 na-enye 1-2/7=5/7.

l-m-h2-b0d06-21.title: Ebee ka njehie ngwọta variance dị?
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) maka variance mgbanwe mberede X nzọụkwụ n’usoro, chọta mmejọ mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.material: Mgbanwe mberede X na-ewere uru 1, 2, 3 nwere ohere 1/2, 1/3, a n’usoro ahụ. Nke a bụ ngwọta variance. Nzọụkwụ 1: ohere ndị ahụ gbakọtara bụrụ 1, ya mere a=1/6. Nzọụkwụ 2: E(X)=1×1/2+2×1/3+3×1/6=5/3. Nzọụkwụ 3: E(X²)=10/3, ya mere V(X)=10/3-5/3=5/3.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s1.r.a: Ịchọta a=1/6 ka ngụkọta bụrụ 1 ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s1.r.d: V(X)=5/9 ziri ezi, ya mere 5/3 ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s1.explain: V(X)=E(X²)-{E(X)}². Ị ga-eme square nke E(X), gbakọọ 10/3-25/9=5/9.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s2.model.0: Na nzọụkwụ 3, a ga-eme square nke E(X), ọ bụghị iwepụ ya dịka ọ dị; ya mere dozie ka V(X)=10/3-(5/3)²=10/3-25/9=5/9.
l-m-h2-b0d06-21.s.s2.model.1: Variance bụ nkezi square e wepụrụ square nke nkezi; iji {E(X)}²=25/9 na-enye 30/9-25/9=5/9.

l-m-h2-b0d06-22.title: Ohere njikọ gafere 1
l-m-h2-b0d06-22.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta) maka ohere njikọ nke ihe omume abụọ na-enweghị ịdabere, chọta mmejọ mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-m-h2-b0d06-22.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ịchọta P(A∪B) mgbe A na B enweghị ịdabere na ibe ha, P(A)=0.4, P(B)=0.5. Nzọụkwụ 1: enweghị ịdabere pụtara P(A∩B)=0.4×0.5=0.2. Nzọụkwụ 2: P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)+P(A∩B). Nzọụkwụ 3: 0.4+0.5+0.2=1.1.
l-m-h2-b0d06-22.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ha enweghị ịdabere, a chọtara P(A∩B)=0.2 site n’ịmụba. Nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-22.s.s1.r.c: Mgbakọ mgbakwunye ziri ezi. Usoro ahụ ezighị ezi.

l-m-h2-b0d01-05.goal: Tụgharịa nha anya ịchọta uru log₈4 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nha anya, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.material: Ka x bụrụ uru log₈4. N’iji nkọwa logarithm, anyị chọrọ ịtụgharị ya ka ọ bụrụ nha anya exponential nke anyị nwere ike iji chọta x.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nha anya nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara na log₈4=x?
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nha anya gbanwere ọnọdụ ntọala na ihe a na-achọ logarithm.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-atụgharị logarithm ka ọ bụrụ ịmụba. Logarithm pụtara exponent.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ nha anya gbanwere ọnọdụ ntọala na exponent.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s1.explain: logₐb=x nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara na aˣ=b. Site na 8ˣ=4, 2³ˣ=2², ya mere x=2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s2.model.0: log₈4=x na-ajụ exponent a ga-eji bulie 8 ka o bụrụ 4; ya mere ọ bụ 8ˣ=4. Ebe 8=2³ na 4=2², x=2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s2.model.1: Site na nkọwa logarithm, logₐb=x ⇔ aˣ=b, ya mere anyị nwere ike ide 8ˣ=4. Ebe 2³ˣ=2², 3x=2, x=2/3.

l-m-h2-b0d01-11.goal: Gosipụta eserese y=2ˣ e bugara 3 n'aka nri n'ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.material: Anyị chọrọ iji ịmụba ma ọ bụ nkewa kọwaa eserese y=2ˣ e bugara 3 n'akụkụ axis x.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nha na-anọchi anya otu eserese?
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ eserese e bugara elu site na 3.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ eserese nke uru y e mụbara site na 3.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ eserese e bugara 3 n'aka ekpe. Ọ bụ otu ihe na ịmụba site na 8.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s1.explain: Nha e bugara 3 n'aka nri bụ y=2^(x−3), 2^(x−3)=2ˣ÷2³=2ˣ÷8.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s2.model.0: Itinye x−3 n'ọnọdụ x na-enye y=2^(x−3), ebe 2^(x−3)=2ˣ÷2³, anyị nwere ike ide y=2ˣ÷8.
l-m-h2-b0d01-11.s.s2.model.1: Dịka iwu exponent aᵐ⁻ⁿ=aᵐ÷aⁿ si dị, 2^(x−3)=2ˣ÷8. Ibugharị n'aka nri bụ otu ihe na ịmụba uru y site na 1/8.

l-m-h2-b0d01-16.title: Iji okirikiri unit kọwaa sine nke θ+π
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.goal: Gosipụta sin(θ+π) dịka isi dị n'okirikiri unit n'ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.material: N'okirikiri unit, ka P(cosθ, sinθ) bụrụ isi ebe akụkụ njedebe θ zutere okirikiri ahụ. Anyị chọrọ iji mmekọrịta isi Q ebe θ+π zutere okirikiri kọwaa sin(θ+π).
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ka esi enweta Q site n'ịkwaga P?
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.o.a: Isi e gosipụtara n'akụkụ axis x
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.r.a: Ngosipụta n'akụkụ axis x na-anọchi anya akụkụ −θ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.o.c: Isi e gosipụtara n'akụkụ axis y
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.r.c: Ngosipụta n'akụkụ axis y na-anọchi anya akụkụ π−θ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.o.d: Isi ahụ bugharịrị π n'aka nri
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.r.d: A tụgharịrị ya π gburugburu okirikiri, e bugharịghị ya.
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s1.explain: Ịtụgharị π ọzọ na-enye isi na-emegide ya. Q=(−cosθ, −sinθ); ya mere sin(θ+π)=−sinθ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s2.model.0: Ịtụgharị ọkara gburugburu ọzọ (π) site na θ na-enye isi na-emegide ya; ya mere Q=(−cosθ, −sinθ), sin(θ+π)=−sinθ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-16.s.s2.model.1: Ntụgharị uche gafee mmalite na-agbanwe akara nhazi x na y abụọ; ya mere nhazi y sinθ na-aghọ −sinθ.

l-m-h2-b0d01-27.goal: Gosi usoro e nwetara site n’iwere logarithm nke okwu ọ bụla n’usoro geometric n’ụdị ọzọ (nhata, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.material: Lee usoro log₂3, log₂6, log₂12, log₂24, … nke e nwetara site n’iwere log₂ nke okwu ọ bụla n’usoro geometric 3, 6, 12, 24, … .
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s1.prompt: Ụdị usoro ọnụọgụ̀ dị aṅaa ka nke a bụ?
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụghị usoro arithmetic ma ọ bụ geometric
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s1.r.a: Ọdịiche ahụ bụ 1 mgbe niile, ya mere ọ bụ usoro arithmetic.
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s1.r.b: Ọdịiche dị n’etiti okwu ndị agbata obi bụ otu mgbe niile, ma ratio ya abụghị otu mgbe niile.
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s1.r.c: Ọdịiche dị n’etiti okwu ndị agbata obi bụ log₂2=1, ọ bụghị 2.
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s1.explain: Ebe log₂aₙ=log₂3+(n−1)·log₂2, ọ bụ usoro arithmetic nke na-abawanye site na 1 n’okwu ọ bụla.
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s2.model.0: Ebe log₂aₙ=log₂3+(n−1)·log₂2, ọ bụ usoro arithmetic nwere ọdịiche nkịtị 1, na-abawanye site na 1 n’okwu ọ bụla.
l-m-h2-b0d01-27.s.s2.model.1: N’ihi na ratio okwu ndị agbata obi bụ 2, iwere logarithm na-eme ka ọdịiche ahụ bụrụ 1 mgbe niile, dịka log₂6−log₂3=log₂2=1.

l-m-h2-b0d01-31.title: Ịgbanwe ebe mmalite Sigma
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.goal: Gbanwee ngụkọta e ji sigma dee ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.material: Ngụkọta Σ_{k=3}^{7} (k−2) pụtara ịgbakwunye (k−2) site na k=3 ruo 7. Anyị chọrọ ịchọta okwu sigma ọzọ nwere otu uru ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-anọchi anya otu ngụkọta ahụ?
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ 3+4+5+6+7, ya mere uru ya dị iche na ngụkọta mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s1.r.b: Ịgbakwunye site na 1 ruo 7 na-enye okwu abụọ ọzọ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-agbakwunye site na −1 ruo 3, ya mere uru ya dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s1.explain: Itinye j=k−2 na-eme ka k=3 ruo 7 ghọọ j=1 ruo 5, na 1+2+3+4+5=15, ya mere ngụkọta ahụ bụ otu.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s2.model.0: Itinye j=k−2 na-eme ka k=3 ruo 7 ghọọ j=1 ruo 5, ya mere Σ_{j=1}^{5} j=15, otu ihe ahụ na ngụkọta mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d01-31.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta mbụ bụ 1+2+3+4+5, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ na Σ_{j=1}^{5} j, ebe a gbanwere ebe mmalite ka ọ bụrụ 1, ma dee okwu ahụ dị ka j.

l-m-h2-b0d01-36.title: Iji domino kọwaa usoro induction
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.goal: Gbanwee usoro induction e gosiri site na domino ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.material: A na-atụnyere induction mgbakọ na mwepụ na domino. Anyị chọrọ ikwu “ọ bụ eziokwu maka n=1” na “ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ eziokwu maka n=k, ọ bụkwa eziokwu maka n=k+1” n’ụzọ domino.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta nke kwekọrọ na “ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ eziokwu maka n=k, ọ bụkwa eziokwu maka n=k+1” bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nzọụkwụ mbụ, ịlele ọnọdụ n=1.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.r.b: Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwubi okwu anyị chọrọ igosi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.o.c: Domino nke k buru ibu karịa nke (k+1)
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.r.c: Ịtụnyere nha enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na usoro induction.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na domino nke k ada, nke (k+1) ga-adakwa
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s1.explain: Nzọụkwụ induction bụ njikọ na-ekwu na mgbe domino ọ bụla dara, nke na-esote ya na-adakwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s2.model.0: Na ọ bụ eziokwu maka n=k pụtara na domino nke k ada; ebe ọ bụkwa eziokwu maka n=k+1, domino na-esote ya na-adakwa.
l-m-h2-b0d01-36.s.s2.model.1: Ịkwatu naanị domino mbụ ezughị; njikọ na-ekwu na mgbe domino ọ bụla dara, nke na-esote ya na-adakwa bụ usoro induction.

l-m-h2-b0d02-04.material: Anyị chọrọ iji akara mgbọrọgwụ dee 16^(3/4), nke nwere ike nkewa, ma chọta uru ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ 16^(4/3), ebe e gbanwere ebe ọnụọgụ dị n'elu na nke dị n'okpuru.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.r.b: Ike 3/4 abụghị ọnụọgụ a ga-eji mụbaa; ọ na-egosi ike.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ dị n'okpuru 4 abụghị nke a ga-eji kewaa; ọ bụ akara ogo mgbọrọgwụ.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ dị n'okpuru 4 pụtara mgbọrọgwụ nke 4, nke dị n'elu 3 pụtara ibuli na ike nke atọ; ya mere 16^(3/4)=(⁴√16)³=2³=8.
l-m-h2-b0d02-04.s.s2.model.1: Ebe 16^(1/4)=2, 16^(3/4)=(16^(1/4))³; ya mere enwere ike ideghachi ya dịka 8, nke bụ 2 e buliri na ike nke atọ.

l-m-h2-b0d02-10.goal: Gbanwee ngosipụta log 2000 e dere site na iji log 2 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d02-10.material: log 2≈0.301. Anyị chọrọ iji log 2 dee logarithm nkịtị log 2000 ma tụọ uru ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-10.s.s1.r.b: 2000=2×1000, ya mere ngwaahịa ahụ na-aghọ nchikọta. Ọ bụghị ugboro 3.
l-m-h2-b0d02-10.s.s1.r.c: Ị kwesịrị ịgbakwunye log 1000=3, ọ bụghị 1000 n'onwe ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-10.s.s2.model.1: Logarithm nke ngwaahịa bụ nchikọta logarithm ndị ahụ, ya mere log(2×10³)=log 2+3, uru ya dịkwa ihe dịka 3.301.

l-m-h2-b0d02-19.title: Ịkọwa eserese cos dịka mgbanwe nke eserese sin
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.goal: Gbanwee nkọwa y=cosx dịka mgbanwe nke y=sinx ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.material: Anyị chọrọ igosi eserese y=cos x dịka mgbanwe nke eserese y=sin x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu eserese hà nhata y=cos x?
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.a: y=sin x ebugharịrị gaa n’aka ekpe site na π/2
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.b: y=sin x ebuliri elu site na π/2
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.b: Ịbugo elu naanị na-agbakwunye π/2 na uru y, nke dị iche na cos x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.c: y=sin x ebugharịrị gaa n’aka nri site na π
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.c: sin(x−π)=−sin x, ya mere ọ bụghị cos x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.o.d: y=sin x ebugharịrị gaa n’aka nri site na π/2
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.d: sin(x−π/2)=−cos x, ya mere ọ tụgharịrị ihu ala.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.explain: cos x=sin(x+π/2). Ịbugharị eserese sin gaa n’aka ekpe site na π/2 na-enye eserese cos.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s2.model.0: Ebe cos x=sin(x+π/2), ọ bụ y=sin x ebe e dochiri x na x+π/2, ya bụ eserese ebugharịrị gaa n’aka ekpe site na π/2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s2.model.1: sin x na-eru 1 mgbe x=π/2, cos x erukwa 1 mgbe x=0; ya mere ịbugharị eserese sin gaa n’aka ekpe site na π/2 na-eme ka ọ dakọọ na eserese cos.

l-m-h2-b0d02-28.title: Ịkọwa ọdịiche nkịtị usoro arithmetic dịka mkpọda ahịrị
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.goal: Degharịa ọdịiche nkịtị nke usoro arithmetic n'ụgbọ nhazi n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.material: Ọ bụrụ na i tụọ isi (n,aₙ) nke usoro arithmetic aₙ=2n+1 n'ụgbọ nhazi, ị ga-enweta (1, 3),(2, 5),(3, 7),…; isi ndị a dị n'otu ahịrị.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe dị n'ahịrị ahụ ka ọdịiche nkịtị usoro a hà nhata?
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s1.r.a: Y-intercept 1 bụ uru mgbe n=0. Ọdịiche nkịtị bụ 2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s1.r.c: X-intercept bụ uru n mgbe aₙ=0. Ọ dị iche na ọdịiche nkịtị.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s1.o.d: Anya dị n'etiti mmalite na ahịrị
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s1.r.d: Anya ahụ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ọdịiche nkịtị.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s1.explain: Mgbe n na-abawanye site na 1, aₙ na-abawanye site na 2. Ya mere mkpọda bụ 2, nke hà nhata ọdịiche nkịtị 2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s2.model.0: Ebe aₙ na-abawanye 2 oge ọ bụla n na-abawanye 1, mkpọda bụ 2, nke hà nhata ọdịiche nkịtị 2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-28.s.s2.model.1: Mkpọda ahịrị gafere isi (1, 3) na (2, 5) bụ (5−3)/(2−1)=2; ya mere anyị nwere ike ikwu na ọ hà nhata ọdịiche nkịtị.

l-m-h2-b0d03-06.goal: Dee nkwupụta “ọrụ ahụ na-aga n'ihu mgbe x=2” n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.material: Anyị chọrọ ideghachi nkwupụta na ọrụ f na-aga n'ihu mgbe x=2 dịka nhatanha nke na-eji oke na uru ọrụ ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s1.r.b: Uru ọrụ ahụ ịbụ 0 enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịdịga n'ihu.
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s1.r.c: Oke ahụ ekwesịghị ịbụ 0. Ọ ga-abụrịrị hà na f(2).
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s1.r.d: Nke a pụtara ọrụ na-adị otu mgbe niile, nke dị warara nke ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s1.explain: Ịga n'ihu pụtara na oke dị, uru ya hàkwa na uru ọrụ f(2).
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s2.model.0: Ka x na-abịaru 2 nso, f(x) na-abịaru f(2) nso; ya mere nke a pụtara otu ihe na nhatanha nke na-ekwu na oke na uru ọrụ hà.
l-m-h2-b0d03-06.s.s2.model.1: Ịga n'ihu n'enweghị nkwụsị pụtara na oke dị, uru ya bụkwa f(2); ya mere a pụrụ ide ya dịka lim f(x)=f(2).

l-m-h2-b0d03-16.title: Mgbanwe akara derivative dịka ọdịdị eserese
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.goal: Degharịa okwu “akara f' na-agbanwe site na + gaa na − mgbe x=2” n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.material: N’aka ekpe nke x=2, f'(x)>0; n’aka nri, f'(x)<0, f na-aga n’ihu n’enweghị nkwụsị mgbe x=2. Kwuo nke a site n’ịkọwa ọdịdị eserese f.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta nke nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe x=2 ọ na-agbada, wee rịgoro, rute ala
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.r.a: Ịgbanwe site na + gaa na − pụtara na ọ na-abawanye wee belata, ya mere ọ bụ elu (oke kacha elu mpaghara).
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.o.b: Mgbe x=2 ọ na-aga n’ihu ịrịgo
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.r.b: N’aka nri, f'<0, ya mere ọ na-agbada.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.o.c: Mgbe x=2 ọ na-arịgo, wee daa, rute elu
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.r.d: Ebe f na-aga n’ihu n’enweghị nkwụsị, ọ naghị agbaji.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ f'>0, f na-abawanye; ma ọ bụrụ f'<0, f na-ebelata. Mgbe x=2, ebe ọ si n’ịbawanye gaa n’ibelata, e nwere oke kacha elu mpaghara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s2.model.0: N’aka ekpe f'>0, ya mere eserese ahụ na-arịgo; n’aka nri f'<0, ya mere ọ na-agbada; ọdịdị ya nwere oke kacha elu mpaghara na x=2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-16.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ọ si n’ịbawanye gaa n’ibelata, e nwere elu na x=2, nke pụtara otu ihe ahụ na akara derivative na-agbanwe site na + gaa na −.

l-m-h2-b0d03-27.title: Ịgbanwe integral nwere oke ka ọ bụrụ usoro mpaghara
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.goal: Dee integral nwere oke nke ọsọ v(t)=2t site na sekọnd 0 ruo 4 n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.material: Ọsọ nke ihe bụ v(t)=2t (m/s). Were anya n'ebe dị anya ∫2t dt ọ gara site na sekọnd 0 ruo 4 dịka ọdịdị dị n'okpuru eserese ahụ, ma gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ usoro mpaghara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ngosipụta na-enye otu uru ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ mpaghara akụkụ anọ. N'okpuru eserese ahụ bụ triangle, ya mere ọ bụ ọkara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.r.b: I were ịdị elu dịka 2. Mgbe t=4, v=8.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.r.c: I were ntọala dịka 8. Ogologo etiti oge ahụ bụ 4.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s1.explain: N'okpuru y=2t e nwere triangle nwere ntọala 4 na ịdị elu v(4)=8. Mpaghara ya, 16, hà na uru integral nwere oke.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s2.model.0: N'etiti eserese v=2t na ahịrị t e nwere triangle akụkụ aka nri nwere ntọala 4 na ịdị elu 8; ya mere mpaghara ya (1/2)×4×8=16 hà na integral nwere oke.
l-m-h2-b0d03-27.s.s2.model.1: Ọsọ bụ 8 mgbe t=4 ma na-abawanye nwayọọ site na 0 ruo 4, ya mere ọdịdị ahụ bụ triangle. A pụrụ ide integral nwere oke dịka (1/2)×4×8.

l-m-h2-b0d03-28.title: Iji differentiation kọwaa ihe integral enweghị oke pụtara
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.goal: Dee integral enweghị oke ∫(3x²+2x)dx n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.material: ∫(3x²+2x)dx = x³+x²+C. Jiri differentiation kọwaa n'ụzọ ọzọ ihe integral enweghị oke pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.o.a: Ọrụ niile nke na-enye 3x²+2x mgbe e mere ha differentiation
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.r.b: A gbanweela ntụziaka ya. Ọ bụ ọrụ dị tupu differentiation, ọ bụghị nsonaazụ differentiation.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụghị uru otu mpaghara, kama ọ bụ nchịkọta ọrụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụgodị na C dị iche, differentiation na-enye otu nsonaazụ, ya mere x³+x²+5 sokwa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s1.explain: N'agbanyeghị uru C, differentiation x³+x²+C na-enye 3x²+2x. Integral enweghị oke pụtara ọrụ niile dị otú ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s2.model.0: Differentiation x³+x²+C na-eme ka C pụọ ma nye 3x²+2x; ya mere integral enweghị oke bụ ọrụ niile na-enye 3x²+2x mgbe e mere ha differentiation.
l-m-h2-b0d03-28.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụgodị na constant C dị iche, nsonaazụ differentiation ka bụ otu. Ya mere ọ pụtara ọrụ niile na-enye 3x²+2x mgbe e mere ha differentiation, ọ bụghị otu ọrụ naanị.

l-m-h2-b0d04-06.title: Idegharị |x−3|/(x−3) site n'oke interval
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.goal: Degharịa okwu |x−3|/(x−3) n'ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.material: Anyị chọrọ ide f(x)=|x−3|/(x−3) (x≠3) site n'interval n'enweghị absolute value. Nke a na-enyere mgbe a na-ese eserese ma ọ bụ na-enyocha oke si n'aka ekpe na aka nri.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nke na-egosi otu ọrụ ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.r.a: Akara ndị ahụ gbanwere ọnọdụ. Itinye x=4 na-enye 1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ x=2, |−1|/(−1)=−1; ya mere ọ dabaghị.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.r.d: Numerator na denominator hà nhata n'ogo; ya mere uru bụ ±1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x>3, |x−3|=x−3; ya mere nkewa bụ 1. Ọ bụrụ x<3, |x−3|=−(x−3); nkewa bụ −1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ x>3, |x−3|=x−3; ya mere nkewa bụ 1. Ọ bụrụ x<3, |x−3|=−(x−3); ya mere ọ bụ −1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-06.s.s2.model.1: Itinye x=4 na-enye 1/1=1; itinye x=2 na-enye 1/(−1)=−1; ya mere site n'interval ọ bụ 1 na −1.

l-m-h2-b0d04-16.title: Iji ụdị ọzọ dee derivative f'(3)
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.goal: Dee derivative f'(3) n'ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d04-16.material: f'(3) bụ oke (f(3+h)−f(3))/h ka h→0. Ka x=3+h, jiri x dee ya ọzọ dịka ngosipụta nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara.

l-m-h2-b0d04-17.material: Mkpọda ahịrị tangent na eserese y=f(x) n'ebe (2, 5) dị bụ 3. Anyị chọrọ iji f na f' dee nkwupụta a dịka ngosipụta.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere nhazi x na y. Isi ihe bụ x=2, y=5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.r.c: A gbanwere uru ọrụ na mkpọda.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.r.d: E jiri y-coordinate 5 mee uru derivative kama mkpọda.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s1.explain: Ebe eserese ahụ gafere na (2, 5), f(2)=5; mkpọda tangent n'ebe ahụ bụ f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s2.model.0: Ebe isi (2, 5) dị n'elu eserese ahụ, f(2)=5; mkpọda tangent bụ uru derivative, ya mere f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-17.s.s2.model.1: Uru ọrụ n'ebe x-coordinate 2 dị bụ 5, ya mere f(2)=5; mkpọda n'ebe ahụ bụ 3, ya mere anyị na-ede f'(2)=3.

l-m-h2-b0d04-26.goal: Dee mgbanwe ọnọdụ site na t=1 ruo t=5 n'ụdị ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.material: Maka ihe na-agagharị n'ahịrị, ka s(t) bụrụ ọnọdụ ya, v(t) bụrụ ọsọ ya n'oge t. Anyị chọrọ iji integral nwere oke degharịa mgbanwe ọnọdụ site na t=1 ruo t=5, s(5)−s(1).
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ mgbanwe ọsọ. Ọ bụghị mgbanwe ọnọdụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s1.o.b: Integral nwere oke nke v(t) site na 1 ruo 5
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s1.o.c: Integral nwere oke nke s(t) site na 1 ruo 5
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s1.r.c: Ịjikọta ọnọdụ na-enye ụdị ọnọdụ mụbara na oge.
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ nkezi nke ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ. Ọ bụghị mgbanwe ha.
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s1.explain: Ebe s'(t)=v(t), ijikọ v site na 1 ruo 5 na-enye s(5)−s(1). Ịjikọta ọsọ na-enye mgbanwe ọnọdụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s2.model.0: Ọsọ v bụ derivative nke ọnọdụ s; ya mere ijikọ v site na 1 ruo 5 na-enye s(5)−s(1), nke hà na mgbanwe ọnọdụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-26.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba ọsọ ozugbo na obere oge ma chịkọta ya na-enye ebe dị anya a gara; ya mere integral nwere oke nke v site na 1 ruo 5 bụ s(5)−s(1).

l-m-h2-b0d05-25.goal: Degharịa ọnụọgụ azịza integer na-adịghị mma nke x+y+z=5 n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.material: Ị chọrọ ịgụ atọ (x,y,z) integer na-adịghị mma mezuru x+y+z=5. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ ndụ kwa ụbọchị, chee nsogbu pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nsogbu nke pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.o.a: Ikesa ihe 5 dị iche iche n'etiti mmadụ 3
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nsogbu 3⁵ nke ikpebi onye ga-enweta ihe nke ọ bụla; ya mere ọ dị iche na azịza nchikọta 5.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.r.b: Ị gaghị ahọrọ 5 n'ime 3. Ọnọdụ a dị iche na ọnụọgụ azịza.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.o.c: Ịhọrọ ụdị 3 n'ime ụdị 5, enwere ike imegharị
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.r.c: Agbanwere ọnụọgụ ụdị na ọnụọgụ a họọrọ. 3H5 na 5H3 dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.o.d: Ịhọrọ 5 n'ime ụdị 3, enwere ike imegharị
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x,y,z bụ ọnụọgụ ụdị atọ, ọ bụ ọnụọgụ ụzọ nchikọta ha bụ 5. Nke a hà nhata combination repetition 3H5=7C2=21.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ x,y,z bụ ọnụọgụ a họọrọ nke ụdị nke ọ bụla, nchikọta bụ 5; ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ dị ka ịhọrọ 5 n'ime ụdị 3 na-emegharị.
l-m-h2-b0d05-25.s.s2.model.1: Ikpebi ole ụdị nke ọ bụla a ga-ahọrọ bụ otu ihe ahụ dị ka ikpebi azịza (x,y,z); ya mere ọ hà nhata 3H5, ụzọ 21.

l-m-h2-b0d06-26.goal: Gbanwee ohere hà nhata P(X≥54) n’ime nkesa nkịtị ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.material: Mgbe X na-agbaso nkesa nkịtị N(50, 4²), anyị chọrọ idegharị P(X≥54) dịka okwu ọzọ maka otu ohere ahụ. Eserese nkesa nkịtị nwere symmetry aka ekpe na aka nri gburugburu nkezi 50.
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ohere na-adị nhata P(X≥54) mgbe niile?
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ohere nke na-agbakọta na P(X≥54) ka ọ bụrụ 1, ya mere ha abụghị otu.
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ oghere etiti gburugburu nkezi, ya mere ọ dị iche na ohere ọdụ.
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s1.r.d: 46 ma ọ bụ karịa gụnyere ihe karịrị ọkara, ya mere ọ dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s1.explain: 54 dị 4 n’elu nkezi, ihe kwekọrọ na symmetry ya bụ 46, dị 4 n’okpuru. Mpaghara ọdụ abụọ hà nhata, ya mere P(X≥54)=P(X≤46).
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s2.model.0: 54, nke dị 4 n’aka nri nke nkezi 50, na 46 nke dị 4 n’aka ekpe, nwere symmetry; ya mere ohere ọdụ aka nri na aka ekpe hà nhata.
l-m-h2-b0d06-26.s.s2.model.1: Ịhazi ọkọlọtọ na-enye P(Z≥1), P(X≤46) aghọ P(Z≤-1); ya mere ha hà nhata n’ihi symmetry.

l-m-h2-b0d06-27.title: Iji dee “opekata mpe otu” dịka okwu mgbakọ
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.goal: Gbanwee “opekata mpe otu n’ime A ma ọ bụ B mere” ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.material: Maka ihe omume abụọ A na B, anyị chọrọ ịgbanwe okwu “opekata mpe otu n’ime A na B mere” ka ọ bụrụ okwu ohere. Ilele site n’akụkụ ebe o meghị na-eme ka anyị dee ya mfe.
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.s.s1.r.a: A na-agbakwunye akụkụ ndị jikọrọ ọnụ ugboro abụọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ibu P(A∪B).
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ngụkọta ohere nke ihe megidere ha, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-egosi naanị ọnọdụ ebe ha abụọ mere, nke dị warara karịa “opekata mpe otu.”
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.s.s1.explain: Ihe megidere “opekata mpe otu mere” bụ “ha abụọ emeghị.” Ya mere P(A∪B)=1-P(Aᶜ∩Bᶜ).
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.s.s2.model.0: Ihe megidere ọnọdụ ebe opekata mpe otu mere bụ ebe ha abụọ emeghị; ya mere ọ hà nhata 1 ewepụ P(Aᶜ∩Bᶜ).
l-m-h2-b0d06-27.s.s2.model.1: “Opekata mpe otu mere” na “ha abụọ emeghị” bụ ibe ha megidere; ya mere enwere ike ide ya ọzọ dịka P(A∪B)=1-P(Aᶜ∩Bᶜ).

l-m-h2-b0d01-06.material: Anyị chọrọ ịtụnyere nha 3⁵⁰ na 2⁸⁰ n’enweghị igwe mgbako. Anyị maara 3⁵=243, 2⁸=256.
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ nwere nkwubi okwu ziri ezi na ihe kpatara ziri ezi?
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.o.a: Iche na 3⁵⁰ ka ukwuu n’ihi na ntọala ya ka ukwuu
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ exponent dị iche, a pụghị ikpebi site na ntọala naanị. Nkwubi okwu ahụ ezighịkwa ezi.

l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ buru ibu nke ukwuu, ya mere nke a adịghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma, njehie nwekwara ike ime.
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.o.c: Iwere na 2⁸⁰ ka ukwuu n'ihi na exponent ya ka ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na base dị iche, ịnweghị ike ikpebi site na exponent naanị. Naanị nkwubi okwu ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s1.explain: 3⁵⁰=243¹⁰ na 2⁸⁰=256¹⁰. Exponent hà nhata, ya mere nke nwere base ka ukwuu, 2⁸⁰, ka ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d01-06.s.s2.model.0: 3⁵⁰=(3⁵)¹⁰=243¹⁰, 2⁸⁰=(2⁸)¹⁰=256¹⁰, ya mere exponent hà nhata, 2⁸⁰ nke base ya ka ukwuu ka ukwuu.

l-m-h2-b0d01-09.material: Dozie log_(1/2)(x−1)>log_(1/2)3. Tụlee ma base dị obere karịa 1 na ọnọdụ arụmụka logarithm.
l-m-h2-b0d01-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ngwọta na ihe kpatara ya kacha mma?

l-m-h2-b0d01-09.s.s1.r.b: A chọrọ ọnọdụ arụmụka x−1>0, ya bụ x>1.
l-m-h2-b0d01-09.s.s1.o.d: x>4: hapụ akara nha otu ọ dị maka arụmụka
l-m-h2-b0d01-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na base dị obere karịa 1, ntụziaka akara nha na-atụgharị.
l-m-h2-b0d01-09.s.s1.explain: Base 1/2 bụ ọrụ na-ebelata, ya mere x−1<3; arụmụka x−1>0 dịkwa mkpa, ya mere 1<x<4.
l-m-h2-b0d01-09.s.s2.model.0: Base 1/2 bụ ọrụ na-ebelata, ya mere akara nha na-atụgharị ka x−1<3, ọnọdụ arụmụka x−1>0 dịkwa, ya mere 1<x<4.

l-m-h2-b0d01-20.title: Ogologo ole ka y=sin(2x−π/3) bugharịrị?
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ntụgharị y=sin(2x−π/3), họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.material: Eserese y=sin(2x−π/3) bụ eserese y=sin2x e bugharịrị n'akụkụ axis x. Tụnyere nkwupụta banyere ole na ntụziaka e bugharịrị ya.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta nwere ihe kpatara ziri ezi?
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.a: N'aka ekpe site na π/3: n'ihi na e nwere mwepu, ntụziaka ya bụ nke megidere
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.r.a: Mwepu apụtaghị n'aka ekpe; ị ga-ewepụtakwa 2.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.b: N'aka ekpe site na π/6: n'ihi na akara na-agbanwe mgbe e wepụpụtara ọnụọgụ
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.r.b: x−π/6 bụ ntụgharị n'aka nri. N'aka ekpe bụ x+π/6.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.c: N'aka nri site na π/3: n'ihi na nhatanha nwere −π/3
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.r.c: Iwepụta ọnụọgụ 2 nke x na-enye 2(x−π/6); ya mere ọ bụ π/6.
l-m-h2-b0d01-20.s.s1.o.d: N'aka nri site na π/6: iwepụta 2 iji nweta 2(x−π/6)

l-m-h2-b0d01-32.title: Σk² na (Σk)² hà nhata?
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara Σk² na (Σk)², họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.material: E nwere nkwupụta abụọ. A: Σ_{k=1}^{n} k² = (Σ_{k=1}^{n} k)². B: N’ozuzu, uru abụọ ahụ dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta ziri ezi, gịnịkwa mere?
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.a: A: N’ihi na mgbe n=1, 1 na 1 hà nhata
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.a: Ị pụghị ime nkwubi okwu n’ozuzu site na n=1 naanị. Ha dị iche mgbe n=2.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.b: A: N’ihi na ha abụọ bụ ngụkọta site na 1 ruo n
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị mkpa ma ị buru ụzọ mee square ka ọ bụ buru ụzọ chịkọta.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.c: B: N’ihi na akụkụ aka ekpe na-adị ukwuu mgbe niile karịa akụkụ aka nri
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe n=2, 5<9, ya mere akụkụ aka ekpe pere mpe n’ezie.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.d: B: N’ihi na mgbe n=2, 1²+2²=5 na (1+2)²=9
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.explain: Mgbe n=2, 1²+2²=5 na (1+2)²=9, ya mere ha dị iche. Otu ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ezuru iji gosi na A ezighị ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe n=2, Σk²=1²+2²=5 na (Σk)²=(1+2)²=9, ha dị iche; ya mere A ezighị ezi, B ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta square na square nke ngụkọta ahụ hà nhata n’ihi na (1+2)² na-emepụta okwu njikọ 2·1·2. n=2 bụ ihe akaebe.

l-m-h2-b0d02-05.material: Tụlee nha log₂3 na log₃5 n'ejighị igwe mgbakọ. Ị nwere ike iji usoro iji uru ntụaka 3/2 tụnyere nke ọ bụla n'ime ha.
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.prompt: Olee nke nwere ma nkwubi okwu ziri ezi ma ihe kpatara ya ziri ezi?
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.o.a: log₃5 ka ukwuu: n'ihi na ọnụọgụ dị n'ime ya, 5, ka ukwuu
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe ntọala dị iche, ile naanị ọnụọgụ dị n'ime logarithm ezughị. Ị ga-eji uru ntụaka tụnyere ha.
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.o.b: log₂3 ka ukwuu: n'ihi na ntọala 2 dị obere
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.r.b: Nkwubi okwu ahụ ziri ezi, ma naanị na ntọala pere mpe ezughị dịka ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.o.c: log₂3 ka ukwuu: n'ihi na 3²>2³ na 5²<3³
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.o.d: Ha hà: n'ihi na ha abụọ dị n'etiti 1 na 2
l-m-h2-b0d02-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma ha dị n'otu oke ahụ, uru ha adịghị nhata.

l-m-h2-b0d02-11.material: Nke a bụ tebụl na-atụnyere 2ˣ na x² mgbe x bụ ọnụọgụ eke. Mgbe x=2, 4=4; mgbe x=3, 8<9; mgbe x=4, 16=16; mgbe x=5, 32>25.
l-m-h2-b0d02-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu echiche kacha kwekọọ n'ihe ndị dị na tebụl?

l-m-h2-b0d02-11.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe x=5, 25<32, ya mere e nwere ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-11.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ x buru ibu nke ọma, 2ˣ>x²
l-m-h2-b0d02-11.s.s1.explain: Ruo x=3, x² karịrị ma ọ bụ hà na 2ˣ; ma malite na x=5, 2ˣ ka ukwuu. Ọrụ exponential na-eto site n'ịmụba, ya mere ha na-eto ngwa ngwa karịa.
l-m-h2-b0d02-11.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x=5, 32>25; mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, a na-eji 2 mụbaa 2ˣ oge ọ bụla, ebe uto x² na-adị ntakịrị. Ya mere mgbe x buru ibu nke ọma, 2ˣ ka ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d02-11.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe x=3, 8<9, ya mere anyị apụghị ikwu na 2ˣ>x² bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; ma mgbe x=5, 32>25, ya mere o yiri ka 2ˣ na-aka ukwuu mgbe x ruru oke.

l-m-h2-b0d02-13.topic: Ntụ ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ radian na ogologo arc
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ịchọta ogologo arc nke akụkụ okirikiri, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.material: Chọta ogologo arc nke akụkụ okirikiri nwere radius 6 na akụkụ etiti 60°. Tụlee ngwọta gbasara iji usoro l=rθ.
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.s.s1.r.a: N’usoro l=rθ, a na-atụ θ na radian. Ị gaghị eji degree dịka ha dị.
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.s.s1.o.d: Kewaa gburugburu 12π na 60 iji nweta π/5
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.s.s1.r.d: 60° bụ 1/6 nke okirikiri, ya mere ọ bụ 12π÷6. Ị gaghị ekewa ya na 60.
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.s.s1.explain: N’ime l=rθ, θ bụ radian. Ebe 60°=π/3, l=6×π/3=2π.
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.s.s2.model.0: A na-atụ θ dị n’usoro ahụ na radian, ya mere ị ga-agbanwe 60° ka ọ bụrụ π/3 ma chọta l=6×π/3=2π.
l-m-h2-b0d02-13.s.s2.model.1: Ebe 60° bụ 1/6 nke okirikiri dum, arc ahụ bụ 1/6 nke gburugburu 12π, ya bụ 2π, otu uru ahụ dị na ngwọta gbanwere ya na radian.

l-m-h2-b0d02-23.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ iji chọta akụkụ kachasị ukwuu site n'akụkụ atọ, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.material: Anyị chọrọ ịchọta akụkụ kachasị ukwuu C (nke dị n'ihu akụkụ ogologo 7) na triangle nwere ogologo akụkụ 3, 5, 7. Tụnyere ọtụtụ ngwọta.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s1.o.a: Akụkụ kachasị ogologo bụ 7; ya mere C=90°
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s1.r.a: 7²=49>3²+5²=34; ya mere ọ bụghị akụkụ aka nri, kama ọ bụ akụkụ sara mbara.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s1.r.c: N'iwu Cosine, a ga-ewepụ square nke akụkụ ikpeazụ.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s1.o.d: Iwu Sine: dozie ozugbo site na 7/sinC=5/sinA
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s1.r.d: N'amaghị akụkụ ndị kwekọrọ, ị gaghị edepụta oke iwu Sine.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s1.explain: cosC=(9+25−49)/30=−1/2; ya mere C=120°. Mgbe naanị akụkụ atọ ka e nyere, jiri Iwu Cosine.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s2.model.0: E nyere naanị akụkụ atọ, enweghịkwa akụkụ kwekọrọ; ya mere jiri Iwu Cosine nweta cosC=(9+25−49)/30=−1/2, C=120°.
l-m-h2-b0d02-23.s.s2.model.1: Ebe e nweghị otu ụzọ akụkụ na akụkụ ihu ya, a pụghị iji Iwu Sine. Iwu Cosine na-enye cosC=−1/2; ya mere C=120°.

l-m-h2-b0d02-29.title: 1, −2, 4, −8, … ọ bụ usoro geometric?
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere ma usoro nwere oke nkịtị na-adịghị mma bụ usoro geometric, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.material: Echiche dị iche gbasara ma usoro 1, −2, 4, −8, 16, … ọ bụ geometric. Ka anyị tụnyere echiche ndị ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.prompt: Echiche onye nwere ezi ihe kpatara ya nke ukwuu?
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.o.a: Mba: n'ihi na ọdịiche okwu ndị dị n'akụkụ anaghị anọ otu
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.r.a: Ma ọdịiche na-anọ otu bụ ụkpụrụ maka usoro arithmetic.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ usoro geometric ọbụna ma oke nkịtị adịghị mma.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.o.c: Ee, ọ bụ geometric: oke okwu ndị dị n'akụkụ bụ −2 mgbe niile
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.o.d: Mba: n'ihi na oke nkịtị enweghị ike ịdị njọ
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.r.d: Oke nkịtị nwere ike ịbụ ezigbo nọmba ọ bụla ma e wezụga 0. Nọmba ndị na-adịghị mma kwekwara omume.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s1.explain: −2/1, 4/(−2), na −8/4 niile bụ −2. Ọ bụrụ na oke okwu dị n'akụkụ na-anọ otu, ọ bụ usoro geometric.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s2.model.0: −2÷1, 4÷(−2), na −8÷4 niile bụ −2; ya mere oke okwu dị n'akụkụ na-anọ otu, ọ bụkwa usoro geometric nwere oke nkịtị −2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-29.s.s2.model.1: Ụkpụrụ usoro geometric bụ na oke na-anọ otu; ya mere ọbụna ma akara na-agbanwe, ọ bụ geometric ma oke ahụ bụ otu −2.

l-m-h2-b0d03-07.title: Iji nnukwu ọnụọgụ tụlee ya ma ọ bụ ime ka akụkụ nkewa dị mfe: olee nke doro anya karịa?
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.goal: Tụlee usoro abụọ ma ọ bụ echiche gbasara oke √(x²+4x)−x mgbe x na-aga n'enweghị njedebe; họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.material: A tinyere x=100 wee nweta √10400−100≈1.98, kwuo na oke ahụ dị ihe dịka 2. B mere ka elu dị mfe site n'ịmụba na akụkụ jikọrọ ọnụ, wee nweta 4x/(√(x²+4x)+x), chọta oke ahụ ma kwuo na ọ bụ 2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.prompt: Olee nke gosiri n'ụzọ doro anya na oke ahụ bụ 2?
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Itinye x=100 doro anya karịa
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.r.a: Otu uru enweghị ike ikpebi oke.
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.o.b: B: Ịgbanwe ngosipụta site n'ime ka akụkụ ya dị mfe doro anya karịa
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ doro anya otu aka
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.r.c: Itinye uru bụ atụmatụ; ime ka akụkụ nkewa dị mfe na-eji ngosipụta edozi ya.
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.o.d: Ọ dịghị nke nwere ike ịchọta oke ahụ
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s1.explain: Itinye x=100 bụ atụmatụ n'otu ebe. Ime ka akụkụ nkewa dị mfe na-enye 4/(√(1+4/x)+1), ngosipụta nke na-egosi na oke bụ 2 mgbe x→∞.
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s2.model.0: Itinye naanị x=100 na-agwa gị naanị uru ahụ, ya mere ọ pụghị ikpebi oke; ime ka akụkụ ahụ dị mfe na-egosi na ọ bụ 2. Ya mere ụzọ B doro anya karịa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-07.s.s2.model.1: Ime ka akụkụ ahụ dị mfe na-enye 4/(√(1+4/x)+1), nke na-egosi ihe mere o ji aga 4/2=2 ka x na-eto; ya mere ụzọ B dabara adaba karịa.

l-m-h2-b0d03-17.title: Mgbe f'(a)=0, ahịrị tangent: onye ziri ezi?
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ahịrị tangent nke f(x)=x²−4x+7 mgbe x=2, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.material: Maka f(x)=x²−4x+7, f'(2)=0. A kwuru “ahịrị tangent bụ axis x (y=0),” B kwuo “ahịrị tangent bụ y=3, nke yiri axis x.”
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.prompt: Tụlee nkwupụta abụọ ahụ ma họrọ nke ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.r.a: Naanị mkpọda ahụ bụ 0, f(2)=3, ya mere ọ bụghị y=0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.o.c: Nkwupụta A na B abụọ ziri ezi
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.r.c: E nwere naanị otu ahịrị tangent; ya mere y=0 na y=3 enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu abụọ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.o.d: Nkwupụta A na B abụọ ezighị ezi
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.r.d: B ziri ezi n’ihi na ọ bụ ahịrị nwere mkpọda 0 nke na-agafe isi (2,3).
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị tangent bụ y=3, nwere mkpọda 0, na-agafe isi (2, f(2))=(2, 3).
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s2.model.0: Mkpọda bụ 0, ya mere ahịrị ahụ kwụ ọtọ; isi tangent bụ (2,3), ya mere ahịrị tangent bụ y=3, B ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-17.s.s2.model.1: f'(2)=0 na-agwa naanị mkpọda, f(2)=3 na-ekpebi ịdị elu ebe ọ na-agafe; ya mere axis x y=0 abụghị ahịrị tangent.

l-m-h2-b0d03-29.title: Mpaghara dị n'etiti eserese abụọ: usoro iwepụ hà mkpa?
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.goal: Tụlee usoro abụọ ma ọ bụ echiche gbasara mpaghara dị n'etiti y=x² na y=3x; họrọ nke ka mma, kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.material: y=x² na y=3x na-ezukọta mgbe x=0 na 3. A kwuru na integral nwere oke nke (x²−3x) bụ −9/2, ya mere mpaghara bụ −9/2; B kwuru na integral nke (3x−x²) bụ 9/2, ya mere mpaghara bụ 9/2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi banyere mpaghara ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.o.a: A: Mpaghara na-adịghị mma ga-ekwe omume
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.o.b: A: Wepụ nke dị n'elu na nke dị n'okpuru
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.r.b: A gbanwere usoro nke elu na ala, ya mere akara nsonaazụ ghọrọ nke na-adịghị mma.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.o.c: B: Wepụ ngosipụta nke ala na nke elu
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ kwuru na mpaghara bụ 9/2
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.r.d: Uru A bụ −9/2, ya mere akara ya dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s1.explain: Maka 0≤x≤3, 3x≥x². Mpaghara bụ integral nke (nke dị n'elu)−(nke dị n'okpuru), nke bụ 9/2. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee usoro ahụ, naanị akara ya ga-agbanwe.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s2.model.0: N'ime etiti ahụ y=3x dị n'elu, ya mere anyị ga-ejikọta (3x−x²); mpaghara ahụ dị mma, ya mere B ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-29.s.s2.model.1: Mpaghara enweghị ike ịdị njọ. Anyị ga-ewepụ x² dị n'okpuru na 3x dị n'elu iji nweta 0 ma ọ bụ karịa; ya mere B, nke bụ 9/2, ziri ezi.

l-m-h2-b0d04-07.title: Oke kachasị nke ọrụ continuous: interval mechiri emechi ọ dị mkpa?
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta gbasara uru kacha ukwuu f(x)=1/x na interval (0,1], họrọ nke ka mma, kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.material: f(x)=1/x bụ continuous na interval (0,1]. A kwuru, 'Ebe ọ bụ ọrụ continuous, ọ nwere oke kachasị na interval a'; B kwuru, 'Ebe interval ahụ emechighị emechi, anyị enweghị ike ijide n'aka na oke kachasị dị.'
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Ọ bụrụ continuous, e nwere uru kachasị
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka x na-abịaru 0 nso, f na-ebuwanye; ya mere enweghị uru kachasị.
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s1.r.b: A ezighị ezi. f na-abawanye n'enweghị oke; ya mere enweghị uru kachasị.
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s1.o.c: B: Ọnọdụ interval mechiri emechi adịghị, ya mere a naghị ekwe nkwa
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s1.r.d: B ziri ezi. N'ezie enweghị uru kachasị na interval a.
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s1.explain: Ka x→0+, 1/x na-abawanye n'enweghị oke; ya mere enweghị uru kachasị. Usoro max-min bụ maka ọrụ continuous n'interval mechiri emechi [a,b].
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s2.model.0: Ka x na-abịaru 0 nso, 1/x na-abawanye n'enweghị oke; ya mere (0,1] enweghị uru kachasị. Interval ahụ emechighị emechi; ya mere B ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-07.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji usoro na-ekwe nkwa uru kachasị naanị maka continuity n'interval mechiri emechi; ya mere na (0,1], nke mepere n'otu nsọtụ, anyị enweghị ike ikwu ihe A kwuru.

l-m-h2-b0d04-27.title: Integral nke x³ site na −2 ruo 2 hà na 0 ka ọ bụ 8?
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.goal: Tụlee usoro ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ gbasara uru integral nwere oke nke x³ site na −2 ruo 2; họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.material: A kwuru na ebe etiti ahụ bụ nke nwere akụkụ hà, integral nke x³ site na −2 ruo 2 bụ 2×(integral site na 0 ruo 2)=8. B kwuru tinye −2 na 2 n'ime [x⁴/4], nke na-enye 4−4=0.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s1.o.a: A: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ abụọ hà, mgbe niile mụbaa na 2
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s1.r.a: x³ adịghị mma mgbe x<0, ya mere ọ naghị aghọ 2 ugboro.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s1.o.b: B: Mpaghara abụọ ahụ nwere akara na-emegide ibe ha, ha akagbuo ibe ha
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s1.r.c: Uru 8 na 0 dị iche, ya mere ha abụọ apụghị ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s1.r.d: Itinye −2 na 2 n'ime [x⁴/4] na-enye 4−4, ya mere ọ bụ 0, ọ bụghị 4.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s1.explain: x³ bụ ọrụ odd. Akụkụ x<0 bụ −4, akụkụ x>0 bụ +4, ya mere nchikọta bụ 0. Iwu ịmụba na 2 bụ naanị maka ọrụ even.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s2.model.0: Ebe x³ adịghị mma mgbe x<0, integral site na −2 ruo 0 bụ −4, site na 0 ruo 2 bụ 4; nchikọta bụ 0. Ya mere B ziri ezi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-27.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma akụkụ etiti ahụ hà, akara ndị na-emegide ibe ha na-akagbu. Ya mere A nke mụbara na 2 ezighị ezi, B nke nwetara 4−4=0 ziri ezi.

l-m-h2-b0d04-28.title: Ọ bụrụ na ị mee differentiation ma jikọta ya ọzọ, ị ga-enweta ọrụ mbụ ahụ?
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ gbasara nsonaazụ differentiation f(x) na ijikọ ya ọzọ; họrọ nke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.material: Differentiation f(x)=x²+3 na-enye 2x; integral enweghị oke nke 2x bụ x²+C. A kwuru, “Ya mere ijikọ ọzọ na-enye f(x)=x²+3 kpọmkwem,” B kwuru, “I kwesịrị ịma C iche iji mata ọrụ mbụ.”
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s1.o.a: A: 3 enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na differentiation, ya mere ọ na-adị 3 mgbe niile
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s1.r.a: Differentiation na-eme ka 3 pụọ; ozi iji weghachite ya adịghị.
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s1.r.b: Integral enweghị oke bụ x²+C, ma amabeghị C.
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s1.o.c: B: Ọ bụ x²+C, ya mere ị ga-amata C iche
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s1.r.d: C edozighị na 0. Ọ bụ 3 na mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s1.explain: Ime derivative na-eme ka okwu constant 3 ghọọ 0, ya mere ọ na-apụ. Integral na-enweghị oke bụ x²+C; iji nweta ọrụ mbụ, ozi ọzọ achọrọ bụ C=3.
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s2.model.0: Ime derivative na-eme ka okwu constant 3 pụọ; ya mere ịme integral ọzọ ka na-enye x²+C, naanị ịmara C nwere ike ime ka ị mara ọrụ mbụ.
l-m-h2-b0d04-28.s.s2.model.1: Derivative constant bụ 0; ya mere 2x enweghị ozi gbasara 3, integral na-enweghị oke bụ naanị x²+C.

l-m-h2-b0d05-31.title: Ụzọ abụọ isi mata ma omume abụọ nọọrọ onwe ha
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ iji kpebie ma omume abụọ nọọrọ onwe ha, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.material: Mgbe a tụbara dice otu ugboro, A bụ 'even', B bụ '3 ma ọ bụ obere'. Nwa akwụkwọ S: ha adịghị ka ha na-emetụta ibe ha; ya mere nọọrọ onwe ha. T: P(A∩B)=1/6, P(A)P(B)=1/4 dị iche; ya mere ha anaghị nọọrọ onwe ha.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.prompt: Onye mkpebi ya ka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi?
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.o.a: S: onye chere na enweghị mmetụta
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.r.a: A ga-enyocha nnwere onwe site na P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B), ọ bụghị mmetụta mmadụ.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.o.b: T: onye nyochara ma ngwaahịa hà nhata
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ: enweghị ike ịma n'enweghị ịgbakọ
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.r.c: Ị nwere ike ikpebi site n'ịgbakọ ohere ahụ ozugbo.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.o.d: S: ọ bụ otu dice; ya mere ha nọọrọ onwe ha
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.r.d: Ebe ihu dice otu ahụ ka ejiri maka ha abụọ, ha jikọtara n'ezie.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s1.explain: A na-ekpebi nnwere onwe site na P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B). N'ebe a 1/6≠1/4; ya mere ha anaghị nọọrọ onwe ha.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s2.model.0: T tụnyere P(A∩B)=1/6 na P(A)P(B)=1/4 dịka nkọwa si dị, kwubie na ha anaghị nọọrọ onwe ha n'ihi uru dị iche; ya mere T ka a tụkwasịrị obi.
l-m-h2-b0d05-31.s.s2.model.1: Mmetụta nwere ike ịdị njọ; ya mere onye nyochara kpọmkwem ma ngwaahịa hà nhata ka a tụkwasịrị obi. Iji otu ihu dice maka omume abụọ nwere ike ijikọ ha.

l-m-h2-b0d05-33.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ gbakọrọ ụzọ ole mmadụ 3 n'ime mmadụ 8 ga-esi nweta ọla edo, ọlaọcha na ọla kọpa n'usoro. A: 8×7×6=336. B: buru ụzọ họrọ mmadụ 3 (8C3=56), wee dozie usoro ọla ahụ, 56×6=336. Chee ihe mere uru ha ji hà.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe kpatara uru abụọ ahụ ji hà?

l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.o.b: N'ihi na permutashọn bụ ngwakọta mụbara na 3
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.r.b: 8P3 abụghị 8C3 mụbara na 3 kama ọ bụ 3!=6.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ntụziaka na-ezighi ezi. 8P3 bụ 8C3 mụbara na 6.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.o.d: Uru abụọ ahụ dabara na mberede
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.r.d: 8P3=8C3×3!, ya mere ọ bụghị mberede; ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s1.explain: Ịmụba 8C3, ụzọ isi họrọ mmadụ 3, na 3!=6, usoro mmadụ 3 ahụ, na-agụkwa usoro ha; ya mere ọ na-enye 8P3. 56×6=336, nPr=nCr×r!.
l-m-h2-b0d05-33.s.s2.model.0: Iji 8C3 họrọ mmadụ 3 ma mụbaa na 3!=6, ụzọ isi hazie mmadụ 3 ahụ, na-agụ usoro ha kwa; ya mere hà na 8P3.

l-m-h2-b0d05-34.title: Olee mgbe ọ dị mma iji nkesa nkịtị mee atụmatụ?
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ banyere mgbe a pụrụ iji nkesa nkịtị mee atụmatụ nkesa binomial; họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.material: Ọnụọgụ isi X n'ime atụba mkpụrụ ego na-agbaso nkesa binomial. A: jiri N(200, 100) mee atụmatụ X mgbe atụba 400. B: jiri N(5, 2.5) mee atụmatụ mgbe atụba 10. Kpebie atụmatụ nkịtị nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.prompt: Nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa bụ nkee, gịnịkwa mere?
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.o.a: B: nkezi dị ntakịrị, ya mere ọ ziri ezi karịa
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe atụba dị ole na ole, ogidi nkesa binomial adịchaghị ire ụtọ, ya mere atụmatụ ahụ adịghị eziokwu nke ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.o.b: Ha abụọ nwere p=0.5, ya mere ha ziri ezi otu aka
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma p hà, ka n na-ebuwanye ibu, ka atụmatụ ahụ na-akawanye mma.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.o.c: A: n buru ibu, ya mere ọ dị nso na nkesa nkịtị
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.o.d: B: mgbanwe dị ntakịrị, ya mere ọ ziri ezi karịa
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.r.d: Mgbanwe dị nta naanị ya anaghị eme ka atụmatụ ahụ ka mma.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s1.explain: Ka n na-ebuwanye ibu, ọdịdị nkesa binomial na-abịaru nkesa nkịtị yiri mgbịrịgba nso. Maka atụba 10, ogidi dị ole na ole, ya mere ha anaghị adaba nke ọma.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s2.model.0: Nkesa binomial na-adịwanye nso na nkesa nkịtị ka n na-abawanye; ya mere A, nwere atụba 400, nwere atụmatụ ziri ezi ma bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa.
l-m-h2-b0d05-34.s.s2.model.1: B nwere naanị uru 11 nwere ike ime, ya mere ọ dị iche nke ukwuu na ahịrị dị ire ụtọ; A nwere n=400 ka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa.

l-m-h2-b0d06-28.title: Dice atọ: ohere opekata mpe otu bụ 6
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ịchọta ohere opekata mpe otu 6 pụtara, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ chọtara ohere na opekata mpe otu n’ime dice atọ a tụgharịrị ga-abụ 6. Nwa akwụkwọ A: chọtara ọnọdụ 1, 2, 3 dice na-egosi 6 iche, gbakwunye ha nweta 91/216. Nwa akwụkwọ B: 1-(5/6)³=91/216. Uru abụọ ahụ bụ otu.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.prompt: Mkpebi nke ziri ezi mgbe e jiri ụzọ abụọ ahụ tụnyere bụ nke dị aṅaa?
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.o.a: A na-adị mma karịa mgbe niile
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.r.a: Uru ndị ahụ bụ otu, ya mere izi ezi ha bụ otu; A nwekwara ohere ka ukwuu ịhapụ ọnọdụ ụfọdụ.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.o.b: B nwere ike iji naanị mgbe ihe omume enweghị ịdabere
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.r.b: Enwere ike iji ihe megidere ya ọbụna n’enweghị nnwere onwe. Naanị ịmụba ohere chọrọ nnwere onwe.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.o.c: Uru ndị ahụ bụ otu, ya mere ụzọ abụọ ahụ enweghị ọdịiche
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma azịza hà nhata, ọnụọgụ mgbakọ na ohere mmejọ dị iche.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.o.d: B dị mfe ma nwee obere ohere ichefu ọnọdụ
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s1.explain: Ịgụ kpọmkwem chọrọ ikewa n’ọnọdụ atọ. Ihe megidere ya chọrọ naanị otu ọnọdụ, “enweghị 6 ọ bụla,” ya mere mgbakọ ahụ dị mkpụmkpụ.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s2.model.0: A ga-agbakwunye ọnọdụ niile nke dice 1, 2, 3 na-egosi 6; B na-achọta naanị otu ọnọdụ enweghị 6, ya mere ọ dị mfe.
l-m-h2-b0d06-28.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ ezie na uru abụọ ahụ bụ 91/216, A nwere ike ịhapụ ọnọdụ; B nke ji ihe megidere ya na-eme ka mmejọ dị ole na ole.

l-m-h2-b0d06-29.title: Ọ bụrụ na ule dị mma, onye ahụ na-arịa ọrịa n’ezie?
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ohere mmadụ nwere ọrịa ka nsonaazụ ule dị mma, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.material: 1% nke mmadụ niile nwere ọrịa. 99% nke ndị nwere ọrịa na-enweta nsonaazụ dị mma, 5% nke ndị na-enweghị ọrịa na-enwetakwa nke ọma. Nwa akwụkwọ A: izi ezi ya bụ 99%, ya mere nsonaazụ dị mma pụtara ohere ọrịa 99%. Nwa akwụkwọ B: n’ime mmadụ 1×10⁴ (10,000), 99 n’ime 594 ndị nwetara nke ọma nwere ọrịa, ya bụ ihe dịka 17%.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.o.a: B: gbakọrọ oke ndị nwere ọrịa n’etiti ndị nwetara nsonaazụ dị mma
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.o.b: A: izi ezi bụ 99%, ya mere ọ bụ 99%
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.r.b: 99% bụ ohere nsonaazụ dị mma ma ọ bụrụ na onye ahụ nwere ọrịa; a tụgharịrị ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ: enweghị ike ịgbakọ ya
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.r.c: Enwere ike ịgbakọ ya site n’ọnụọgụ ndị ọrịa na ohere nsonaazụ dị mma.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.o.d: A: ohere inwe ọrịa ma ọ bụrụ na ule dị mma bụ 5%
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.r.d: 5% bụ ohere onye na-enweghị ọrịa ga-enweta nsonaazụ dị mma.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s1.explain: P(positive|disease)=0.99 na P(disease|positive) dị iche. N’ime mmadụ 594 nwetara nke ọma, 99 nwere ọrịa; ya mere P(disease|positive)=99/594≈17%.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s2.model.0: B chọtara oke 99/594 nke ndị nwere ọrịa n’etiti ndị nwetara nke ọma; ya mere mgbakọ ahụ dabara n’ajụjụ a, enwere ike ịtụkwasị ya obi.
l-m-h2-b0d06-29.s.s2.model.1: Ohere nsonaazụ dị mma ma ọ bụrụ na ọrịa dị na ohere ọrịa ma ọ bụrụ na nsonaazụ dị mma dị iche; mgbe ọnụego ọrịa dị ala, nke ikpeazụ pere mpe nke ukwuu.

l-m-h2-b0d06-30.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka iji tụnyere akara ule dị iche, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.material: Ule mgbakọ na mwepụ nwere nkezi akara 50 na deviation ọkọlọtọ 5; ule sayensị nwere nkezi 60 na deviation ọkọlọtọ 10. Tụlee ụzọ atọ onye ka mma n’otu n’otu: nwa akwụkwọ nwetara 65 na mgbakọ na mwepụ ma ọ bụ 75 na sayensị.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu onye ka mma n’otu n’otu?
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.o.a: Tulee nsonaazụ ule ozugbo tụnyere ya: sayensị 75 ka mma.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.r.a: Nnwale ọ bụla nwere nkezi na mgbasa dị iche, ya mere enweghị ike iji akara ozugbo tụnyere ha.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.o.b: Nnwale ndị ahụ dị iche, enweghị ike iji ha tụnyere.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na i hazie akara ọkọlọtọ, ị nwere ike iji ọbụna ule dị iche tụnyere.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.o.c: Hazie akara ọkọlọtọ ma tụnyere: mgbakọ na mwepụ 65 ka mma.
l-m-h2-b0d06-30.s.s1.o.d: Ebe dị n'etiti nkezi hà, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ ahụ hà.

l-m-h2-b0d06-32.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma uru atụ anya hà, mgbasa nsonaazụ ha dị iche, ya mere ha abụghị otu ihe.

l-m-h2-b0d06-32.s.s1.r.b: Isi 0 nwekwara ike ịpụta, uru atụ anya ha hà, ya mere enweghị ike ikwu na ọ ka mma mgbe niile.
l-m-h2-b0d06-32.s.s1.o.c: A ka mma mgbe niile n'ihi na akara ya anaghị agbanwe.
l-m-h2-b0d06-32.s.s1.r.c: Nke ka mma dabere n'otú ị chọrọ izere ihe ize ndụ.
l-m-h2-b0d06-32.s.s1.o.d: Uru atụ anya hà, ma variance dị iche: 0 na 9.

l-m-h2-b0d02-09.title: Ibelata mkpọtụ: Ijikọta decibel na ọnụ ahịa
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.goal: Maka ọrụ mgbochi ụda iji belata mkpọtụ, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-adọrịta, họrọ mkpebi kacha mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.material: Ogo mkpọtụ bụ L=10log(I/I₀) dB. Anyị chọrọ iwetu mkpọtụ 80 dB dị ugbu a ka ọ bụrụ 60 dB ma ọ bụ ala. A na-ekpebi ọrụ mgbochi ụda site n'oke ole ike ụda I ga-adị (1 n'ime ole), ọnụ ahịa ya ekwesịghịkwa ịkarị 50.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọrụ ga-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ?
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.r.a: 80−10=70 dB, nke na-abụghị 60 dB ma ọ bụ ala.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.r.b: 80−10log50≈63 dB, nke na-abụghị 60 dB ma ọ bụ ala.
l-m-h2-b0d02-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ewedata mkpọtụ ahụ ruo 50 dB, ma ọnụ ahịa 90 karịrị oke 50.

l-m-h2-b0d02-20.title: Ịrụ ọrụ mgbe ụgbọ mmiri na-agafe n’oge oke mmiri: olee mgbe a ga-amalite?
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.goal: Maka oge mmalite ọrụ nke na-emezu ọnọdụ omimi mmiri, tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.material: Omimi mmiri n’ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri bụ h(t)=4+2sin(πt/6) m (t bụ oge, 0≤t≤12). Ụgbọ mmiri nwere ike ịgafe naanị mgbe omimi ya dịkarịa ala 5 m, ọrụ ịgafe ahụ na-ewe awa 2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge mmalite dabara adaba maka ọrụ ahụ?
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe t=0.5 omimi ya bụ ihe dịka 4.5 m, ya mere ọ dị n’okpuru 5 m ozugbo a malitere.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s1.r.c: Ọrụ ahụ na-aga ruo t=5.5, ma omimi n’oge ahụ bụ ihe dịka 4.5 m, nke dị n’okpuru 5 m.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọrụ ahụ na-aga ruo t=6.5; mgbe t=6 omimi ya bụ 4 m, nke dị n’okpuru 5 m.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s1.explain: Omimi ahụ dịkarịa ala 5 m mgbe 1≤t≤5. Ọrụ awa 2 ga-amalite n’ime 1≤t≤3.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s2.model.0: h(t)≥5 bụ eziokwu mgbe 1≤t≤5; ka ọrụ awa 2 daba n’ime oke a, ọ ga-amalite na t=2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-20.s.s2.model.1: Oge omimi ya dịkarịa ala 5 m bụ site na t=1 ruo t=5, awa 4; ya mere ịrụ ọrụ site na t=2 ruo 4 na-eme ka omimi ahụ dịkarịa ala 5 m oge niile.

l-m-h2-b0d02-24.goal: Maka akwa ifuru triangle ebe a na-ahọrọ akụkụ dị n'etiti, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.material: N'akwa ifuru triangle, akụkụ abụọ bụ 6 m na 8 m; anyị na-ahọrọ akụkụ dị n'etiti ha θ. Mpaghara ga-adị opekata mpe 20 ㎡, akụkụ nke atọ (ogige) ga-abụkwa opekata mpe 12 m.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.s.s1.r.a: Mpaghara bụ 24sin40°≈15.4 ㎡, nke dị ala karịa 20 ㎡.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.s.s1.r.c: Mpaghara dị ihe dị ka 20.8 ㎡, ma akụkụ nke atọ bụ √148≈12.2 m, nke karịrị 12 m.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.s.s1.r.d: Mpaghara bụ 12 ㎡, nke dị ala karịa 20 ㎡.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.s.s1.explain: Mgbe θ=90°, mpaghara bụ 24 ㎡ (≥20), akụkụ nke atọ bụ 10 m (≤12); ya mere ọnọdụ abụọ mezuru.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe θ=90°, mpaghara bụ 24 ㎡, opekata mpe 20, akụkụ nke atọ bụ 10 m, nke na-erughị ma ọ bụ hà 12; ya mere ọnọdụ abụọ mezuru.
l-m-h2-b0d02-24.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ θ dị nta, mpaghara agaghị ezu; ọ bụrụ θ buru ibu, akụkụ nke atọ ga-adị ogologo karịa; ya mere naanị nhọrọ mezuru ha abụọ bụ 90°.

l-m-h2-b0d02-31.goal: Maka ọnụọgụ ahịrị kaadị a kwakọbara, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d02-31.material: A na-akwakọba kaadị: kaadị 1 n'ahịrị mbụ, 3 n'ahịrị nke abụọ, 5 n'ahịrị nke atọ, wdg, na-abawanye 2 ahịrị ọ bụla. Enwere ike iji kaadị 50 kacha; anyị chọrọ opekata mpe ahịrị 6, ma kwakọba ọtụtụ ahịrị o kwere mee.

l-m-h2-b0d02-31.s.s1.r.a: A ga-enwe opekata mpe ahịrị 6. Ahịrị 5 ezughị.
l-m-h2-b0d02-31.s.s1.r.b: Enwere ike iji kaadị 36 mee ya, ma ahịrị 7 (kaadị 49) ka dị n'ime kaadị 50; ya mere i nwere ike ịkwakọba karịa.

l-m-h2-b0d03-21.material: Ngwaahịa na-efu 20 won n'otu mkpụrụ; mgbe ọnụ ahịa bụ p won, ọnụọgụ e rere bụ (100−p). Uru fọdụrụ bụ (p−20)(100−p), ma n'ihi oke ngwaahịa, a ga-ererịrị opekata mpe 50. Họrọ ọnụ ahịa ọnụọgụ dum nke na-enye uru fọdụrụ kacha ukwuu.
l-m-h2-b0d03-21.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ahịa na-enye uru fọdụrụ kacha ukwuu ma na-agbaso ọnọdụ ndị ahụ?

l-m-h2-b0d03-21.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-agbaso ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma uru fọdụrụ bụ 1375, nke dị ala karịa 1500 mgbe p=50.
l-m-h2-b0d03-21.s.s1.r.d: Uru fọdụrụ kacha ukwuu, ma naanị mkpụrụ 40 ka a ga-ere, nke na-erughị 50.
l-m-h2-b0d03-21.s.s1.explain: Uru fọdụrụ kacha ukwuu mgbe p=60, ma 100−p≥50 pụtara p≤50. N'ime oke ahụ, uru fọdụrụ kacha ukwuu mgbe p=50, ya bụ 1500.
l-m-h2-b0d03-21.s.s2.model.0: Anaghị anabata p=60 n'ihi na naanị mkpụrụ 40 ka a na-ere. Maka p≤50, uru fọdụrụ na-abawanye ka p na-abawanye; ya mere p=50 kacha mma.

l-m-h2-b0d04-29.title: Jupụta tank mmiri opekata mpe 20 L n'emeghị ka ọ jubiga
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka oge iji jupụta tank mmiri, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.material: Mmiri na-abata n'ọsọ v(t)=2t (L/min). A ga-etinye opekata mpe 20 L, ikike tank bụ 25 L; ya mere mmiri agaghị ejubiga. Oge T nke a ga-emechi mmiri ga-abụ nke kacha ngwa ngwa.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge T kacha ngwa ngwa mezuru ọnọdụ niile?
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s1.r.a: E tinyere 4²=16 L, nke na-erughị 20 L.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s1.r.c: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ ahụ na 25 L, ma ọ bụ mgbe e mesịrị karịa nkeji 4.5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-aghọ 36 L, na-ejupụta karịa ikike 25 L.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ e tinyere bụ T² L. T=4 na-enye 16 L, nke pere mpe; 4.5 na-enye 20.25 L, nke mezuru ọnọdụ. Ọ na-eme ngwa ngwa karịa 5 na 6.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ e tinyere bụ integral doro anya nke 2t site na 0 ruo T, ya bụ T²; ya mere ọ ga-adị n'etiti 20 na 25. N'ime nhọrọ, 4.5 nkeji bụ nke kacha ngwa ngwa, ọ na-enye 20.25 L; ya mere ọ dabara adaba.
l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s2.model.1: T=4 na-enye 16 L, ezughị; T=6 na-enye 36 L, jubigara. N'ime 4.5 na 5 mezuru ọnọdụ, 4.5 nke mbụ kacha mma.

l-m-h2-b0d04-30.title: Ịhọrọ oge nkwụsị ka ọ dị opekata mpe 12 m ma ije kacha nta
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka oge ịkwụ ụgbọala ahụ ka ọ dịkarịa ala 12 m pụọ, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.material: Ọsọ ụgbọala bụ v(t)=8−2t (m/s); ọ na-akwụsị na sekọnd 4 wee laghachi azụ. A ga-akwụsị ya n'oge T sekọnd n'ebe dịkarịa ala 12 m site n'ọnọdụ mmalite, ebe anya niile e jere ga-abụ nke kacha nta.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu T mezuru ọnọdụ ahụ ma jiri ụzọ kacha nta?
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-aga naanị 7 m site n'ebe mmalite, nke na-erughị 12 m.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, ma anya e jere dị ogologo, 15 m.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị 12 m site n'ebe mmalite, ma ọ tụgharịrị mgbe sekọnd 4 gasịrị ma jee 20 m n'ozuzu.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.explain: Ọnọdụ bụ 8T−T², nke bụ 12 m na T=2. T=6 bụkwa 12 m, ma a gbakwunyere njem nlọghachi 4 m mgbe sekọnd 4 gasịrị, ya mere anya niile bụ 20 m.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s2.model.0: Na T=2, ọnọdụ bụ 8·2−4=12 m; ọnọdụ mezuru, ọ naghị alaghachi azụ, anya ya bụ 12 m kacha nta; ya mere T=2.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s2.model.1: T=6 nwekwara ọnọdụ 12 m, ma ọ laghachiri 4 m mgbe sekọnd 4 gasịrị; anya njem ghọrọ 20 m. Ọ bụ ya mere T=2 ji dabara adaba.
